in_marathi.name: Shushil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shushil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shushil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shushila', which means 'intelligent' or 'wise'. It is a name that is often given to a child who is believed to possess a great deal of intelligence and wisdom from an early age.
